Telangana Voter List Anomalies Spark Controversy Over Public Access

Authorities in Telangana have issued special notices to approximately 93 lakh voters regarding anomalies in the electoral rolls. Hearings for urban voters are scheduled to be held in the evenings, with special campaigns for claims and objections planned for September 5 and 6. Concerns have been raised about the public accessibility of the anomaly lists, with one report questioning why these lists are not being made public. The process aims to address discrepancies and allow voters to file claims and objections.
